Chapter 688 General

A few days ago, Heifu was surprised to see Han Xin's name in the register of meritorious soldiers.

"I sent people to look for him for more than two years, why did he suddenly jump into my bowl!"

Hei Fu always remembers the name of Soldier Immortal. Just like when he was looking for Liu Jixian, he had already arrived at the sugar shop in Jianghuai, and it was Heifu's spy and spies.

But it's a pity that Heifu was forced to remember everything except Han Xin's place of origin. Unfortunately, he knew nothing about this, so he could only look for a needle in the haystack of Chu land, and there were only two information he could provide to the few trustworthy villagers:

"Cut humiliation, Han Xin."

But the Chu land is so vast. After two years of fishing, nothing was found. However, I never thought that I was riding a donkey to find a horse. Han Xin had long been taken to Wuchang Camp by Xiao He and arranged to come to Lingnan.

"Success is Xiao He, failure is Xiao He, these two are really destined."

In order to prevent them from having the same name, he immediately asked Qu Ji to report everything related to Han Xin, and finally determined that this should be the historical soldier immortal. Although except for the humiliation of the crotch, Han Xin's fate has completely changed...

Heifu suddenly smiled and felt that he had gotten a big deal from "buy one, get one free".

There is a future great talent under his command, and he is a guy who has inherited the tradition of the Spring and Autumn and Warring States scholars, "If you don't need it, go," and likes to run away at every turn. Heifu must give him a promotion, and keep him for a while. Summon him to meet him and take a test to see if Han Xin really has the legendary talent.

But even though he was prepared, Han Xin's proposal still surprised Heifu like a thunderbolt.

I had always been optimistic about Han Xin's success, but I didn't expect that he would come up with such a strategy that deviated from common sense. He scolded: "Repeat the same old tricks? You know that the car in front of you is overturned, but you have to follow the same path. Isn't this the way to defeat?"

Han Xin, however, believed in the strategy he proposed:

"Although they appear to be the same, they are actually different. Two years ago, before General Tu fully controlled Xi'ou, he was eager to march to the north of Xianghu. He ventured to advance during the rainy season and was attacked by the Ou people. The partial division was also defeated by the Luo people."

"But as long as you control all the waterways in Xi'ou, build forts everywhere, and use boat divisions to transport grain and fodder, the people of Ou will have no chance to take advantage of them. After the prince controls the land of Ou, he can send the three armies to advance westward, and then let the two groups pretend to be defeated and retreat. Only the elite soldiers with the highest morale along the way were left to go deep alone. When Xiou and Luo people saw that they were alone, they underestimated the small number of our soldiers, so they must go to war. If we fight, one Qin Dynasty can defeat the five Yues. If you are trapped in the dead place, you will survive, and if you leave it in the dead place, you will fight. If you survive, the Qin army will win!

He bowed to Heifu and said: "This is the only way to lure the Yue people into fighting. Han Xin is not talented, but he is willing to lead the elite troops as a pioneer for the king!"

What he didn't say was: "If you believe in me, I can lead the army!"

What a Han Xin, he actually took the initiative to ask for a job. Beneath his superficial restraint and low self-esteem, his majestic enterprising spirit was fully exposed.

Qu Ji shook his head: "It's still too risky..."

"I once said, if you don't enter the tiger's den, how can you catch the tiger's cubs?"

But Heifu smiled and said: "Years ago, Li You and I were trapped in an isolated city in Chu when we attacked Chu. We deceived the people of Chu into trusting them, so I said this. Han Xin's strategy reminded me of that bitter battle. The strategy Although it is dangerous, its ambition can strengthen people's courage..."

Hearing this, Han Xin couldn't help but be overjoyed.

This plan made Heifu start to re-examine Han Xin. At first, he thought "don't pull the seedlings to encourage them" and wanted to slowly promote Han Xin through the school examination. Unexpectedly, this was a seedling that tried its best to emerge.

Although it is still a bit tender, the future is limitless.

Heifu is also a veteran on the battlefield, and he knows that every general has his own unique characteristics in using troops: Li Xin likes to use his sword to deviate, and is good at cavalry attacks; Heifu understands that he has no military talent, so he likes to use the crowd to bully the weak and use force. Bullying the weak, the most important thing in fighting is "coward". If you fight hard, you will never take risks if you can.

Han Xin, on the other hand, is the kind of genius who can be both steady and wavering. Although he plays steadily in the early stage, he will suddenly make an operation that goes against common sense and catch you off guard.

Use the combination of good and evil, use the strategy according to the situation, not only can operate, but can also eat meat. Just when you think you have a great advantage, he will counterattack and hit GG.

Heifu now somewhat understands why Han Xin was able to surpass the four famous generals of the Warring States Period and become the "Soldier Immortal".

"Using both the odd and the right, the more soldiers the better. It's a bit like Wang Jian, but more spiritual than Wang Jian..."

But this kind of talent has always been proud and arrogant. If he is flattered and praised too much, he may float to the sky and become uncontrollable.

So Heifu decided to water the wheat seedling that was eager to emerge. It seemed to be for its own good, but in reality? This is secretly contained.

So he said: "But in this battle, it is not enough for the general to be brave and strategic. We also need a group of soldiers who are not afraid of death and have faith in the general. Only then can we go deep alone and defeat the enemy with a small number... ...Han Xin, how many people do you think this elite army needs?"

Han Xin thought for a while: "Ten thousand!"

"Ten thousand?"

Hei Fu shook his head: "That's the captaincy. In the Qin army, the title matches the position. If you want to pretend to be a captain, you have to be a public servant at least. If you are a commander in other departments, you have to be a senior official. You are not changing it now, In the more than 100 years since Shang Yang's reform in Great Qin, there has never been a captain who did not change his title. Even if I force the appointment, no one will obey you. When the time comes, the soldiers will be suspicious and will not be able to fight a tough battle."

"Therefore, I cannot make you the captain!"

He smiled: "However, Han Xin's suggestion of going up the river and building a barrier around Yushui is a good strategy. If you can control Xiou through this, you will have made a great contribution. You can be promoted to a noble rank by two more levels. Official. Once this strategy is effective, I will immediately send the love letter to Xianyang to ask for your credit!"

"As for the strategy of advancing in separate attacks and attacking from a long distance? When our army takes control of Xi'ou, your title will be enough to take charge alone. I will make a decision later!"

After saying that, Heifu waved his hand: "Quji, take him down."

"promise!"

"Thank you, Lord!"

Han Xin was dissatisfied and bowed his head to thank him, but in Hei Fu's invisible eyes, a trace of disappointment flashed...

In half a year, he was upgraded from regular service to public transport? This is obviously impossible. Military merit, the ladder that inspired the Qin people to climb upward from generation to generation, has now become an obstacle that limits Han Xin's rapid progress.

There was no way, Han Xin's initial status and reputation were too low, and his strategies and ideas often went beyond common sense, making him afraid to let them go.

Those who behave like an expert will definitely see things that are not in the world, and those who have the concern of knowing alone will surely benefit the people.

Han Xin originally thought that the Marquis of Changnan would be different and that he would be a wise master who dared to promote talents. Otherwise, he would not have promoted Xiao He, a county official, to the position of the captain of grain management, in charge of hundreds of thousands of troops.

But he was still disappointed. This monarch could have spread his wings and soared, but he was restrained by Qin's legal decrees and his hands were tied.

He would definitely not run away. Han Xin is a person who knows how to repay his kindness. That would hurt Xiao He and Qu Ji who recommended him. But with the depression in his heart, he might run away one day...

But just when Han Xin was about to step out of his commanding post, Marquis Changnan called out to him!

"Han Xin!"

Han Xin turned around and saw Hei Fu standing up and walking quickly.

As a general in charge of hundreds of thousands of troops, Heifu understands that employees' work passion often comes from the recognition of their bosses, and there are many ways of recognition: such as promotions, salary increases and other major recognitions.

In addition, verbal praise is also an important way, and it doesn’t cost money anyway.

But no matter what the reward is, the key is to make the employee feel that the boss values him and make him truly feel that he is a unique screw...

"Junhou?"

Heifu walked up to Han Xin and sighed: "I just remembered something in a daze. Twelve years ago, just after the decisive battle between Qin and Chu was decided, I was summoned by His Majesty in Huaiyang. His Majesty asked me with a smile, Have you ever thought about becoming a general?"

His Majesty, the First Emperor of Qin, was also well versed in the ways of superiors. He was very proficient in selecting and polishing talents and making people willing to die. For example, Li Xin, who rode a white horse and headed west, was willing to serve as the emperor's pioneer, even if he died, he would not regret it. !

Qin Shihuang paid even more attention to Heifu. He asked about his ambitions, crowned him with a crown, and bestowed words on him...

Behind the emperor's art, is there a trace of true love for talent? Heifu didn't know, but when he tried to imitate this method and used it on his subordinates, he found that there was always some real thing among the fake things, and some real things among the fake things. Sometimes after playing with it too much, even he couldn't tell the difference between the real thing and the real thing. Fake.

Just like now, he said to Han Xin: "I answered your Majesty at that time, do you know what it was?"

How could Han Xin know? He said he didn't know.

Heifu looked at Han Xin: "Therefore, those who are ambitious must want to be generals and seek the title of marquis. Those who do not want to be generals have short ambitions..."

"A soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier! Today, I will give you these words!"

Han Xin's depressed expression suddenly relaxed and was replaced by shock and emotion.

Changnan Hou expressed his deep ambition in just one sentence!

"You are a Qiji who can jump a thousand miles in one leap. But if the trees are so beautiful in the forest, the wind will destroy them. If you rise too fast, you will easily be jealous of others and the road ahead will be difficult. Xunzi said, "If you don't accumulate steps, you can't reach a thousand miles." A small stream cannot become a river or a sea. Young people, they still have to keep their hearts down, eat in one bite and walk step by step."

Heifu pulled Han Xin down to bow to the choked Han Xin, and encouraged him like a promise and an expectation: "I believe that in time, you will also become a general!"
